history.summary: A modern, grand temple complex in Dehu dedicated to Sant Tukaram's literary legacy: a massive three-storey structure spread over ~7 acres with five spires, the central one reaching ~125 feet, housing a panchadhatu (five-metal) idol of Sant Tukaram. Its distinctive feature is that roughly 4,000 of Tukaram's abhanga verses (the Abhang Gatha) are carved on the temple walls, making it a monument to his poetry as much as to his person. Exact construction/inauguration date and builder details are UNVERIFIED from the sources consulted.

name: Sant Tukaram Maharaj Gatha Mandir
town_description: Dehu is a town in Pune district on the banks of the Indrayani river, about 30 km northwest of Pune. It is best known as the birthplace and home of Sant Tukaram, one of Maharashtra's most revered Warkari saints, and is a major pilgrimage centre for the Varkari tradition. The town's annual Ashadhi Palkhi procession to Pandharpur begins here.
